name: Brazilian Zouk
notes: Brazilian Zouk style pack (Doc 04 template, solo-first, with a hard safety rule). Lineage told straight: when lambada's late-80s wave receded, Brazilian dancers — Rio and Porto Seguro lineages — kept the movement language and adapted it to Caribbean zouk music, which gave the dance its (confusing) name: Brazilian Zouk is a Brazilian dance, distinct from Antillean zouk the music genre and unrelated to kizomba. SAFETY LIMIT, enforced like ballet's no-pointe rule: Brazilian Zouk's signature head movement and deep cambrés load the neck and spine — they are trained progressively with qualified instructors and a connected partner, never self-taught from video. NO head-movement move exists in this pack (tested); meta.neck_honesty says why in the curriculum. What solo training honestly owns: the lateral basic's slow-quick-quick, body waves and upper-body isolation, counterbalance and core prep, and the zouk ear.

seasons.finale: Tell the lineage on camera: lambada, Porto Seguro, the zouk music that renamed it. Then film the boom-chik-chik clapped through a track.
Film the lateral basic — slow-quick-quick both directions, weight fully arriving, unhurried.
Film upper-body waves riding one slow zouk track — chest leading, shoulders easy, no neck throwing.
Core and balance prep filmed: the strength a zouk teacher would want to see before any tilted shape.
Find a Brazilian Zouk class or social — the head movement chapter of this dance begins there, with a teacher, not here.

attributes.name: Axis balance L1
attributes.test: 10s single-leg stand each side with a soft knee, eyes forward, then 5s with eyes closed

attributes.name: Counterbalance core L1
attributes.test: 30s controlled hollow-body hold + 10 slow standing torso leans each way, spine long, zero strain

attributes.name: Spine mobility L1
attributes.test: 8 slow cat-cow cycles + 8 gentle standing side-bends each way, smooth through the whole range, pain-free

nodes.name: The zouk beat — boom-chik-chik
checkpoints: the pulse is a slow-quick-quick: boom... chik-chik — clap it until it claps itself
modern floors mix zouk, R&B and lyrical remixes around 60-90 BPM — slow enough to say something
the SLOW is where the dance lives; the quicks just get you to the next slow

nodes.name: Dynamics — riding the vocal
checkpoints: zouk dancers ride the melody and vocal as much as the drums
waves stretch through held notes; footwork answers the percussion
one track, two listens: once for the beat, once for the song

nodes.name: From lambada to Brazilian Zouk
checkpoints: lambada exploded out of Brazil (Porto Seguro's beaches) in the late 1980s — fast, close, wave-driven
when the lambada wave receded, Brazilian dancers kept the movement and adapted it to Caribbean zouk music in the 1990s — that music lent the dance its name
Brazilian Zouk is a BRAZILIAN dance: distinct from Antillean zouk (the Caribbean music genre) and unrelated to kizomba — untangling the names is step one

nodes.name: The scene today — congresses, lineages, consent
checkpoints: Rio and Porto Seguro lineages grew into a worldwide congress-and-social scene
zouk floors run on explicit consent culture — closeness and head movement are always opt-in, asked and answered
learn from teachers who credit the lambada root and teach safety progressions

nodes.name: The safety limit: head movement is learned with a teacher
checkpoints: Brazilian Zouk's signature head movement and deep cambrés load the neck and spine — trained progressively, with qualified instructors and a connected partner, NEVER self-taught from video
no head-movement move exists in this pack, on purpose — the same rule that keeps pointe out of the ballet pack
what you CAN build here is the body that arrives safe: axis, core, spine mobility, and waves that stop at the shoulders

nodes.name: The lateral basic (slow-quick-quick)
nodes.anchor: zouk's home base — learnable in a week
checkpoints: side step on the boom (slow), two smaller steps on the chik-chik — then mirror
the slow step STRETCHES: arrive, keep moving through it, never park
weight fully trades; the upper body stays tall and calm
both directions until neither feels like the good side
mistakes: three even steps — the slow must be twice the length
bobbing up and down; the lateral glides level

nodes.name: Body waves (shoulders down)
checkpoints: chest-led waves rolling through the ribs and hips — the spine articulates, station by station
the wave STOPS AT THE SHOULDERS in this pack: no head throwing, by design
slow is the whole point — one wave can fill four counts
ride a held vocal note with one wave and feel why zouk is danced to slow music
mistakes: whipping the neck to fake amplitude — exactly what this pack refuses to teach
waving arms while the spine stays a plank

nodes.name: Counterbalance & axis prep
checkpoints: controlled standing leans in every direction, core owning the return — solo counterweight rehearsal
slow lateral with a held lean through the slow count
this is the strength a zouk teacher builds tilted shapes on — arrive at class already owning it
mistakes: leaning from the neck instead of the whole axis

nodes.name: Connection prep (solo)
checkpoints: tall elastic posture — zouk connection stretches and rebounds like taffy
lateral basic with a light wall-touch: the hand stays quiet while the body travels
elasticity without collapse is the whole skill

nodes.name: Partnered basics (with a partner)
checkpoints: learned at a zouk class — lateral together, elastic connection, consent asked and answered
head movement remains a classroom chapter with a qualified teacher, later, if you both choose it
your solo lateral and waves are why your first partners will enjoy this

nodes.name: One slow track of flow — filmed
checkpoints: one slow zouk track: lateral traveling, waves on the held notes, one counterbalance moment
shoulders down the whole song — the neck stays a passenger
watch it back at half speed; zouk rewards the slow eye

nodes.name: The zouk room
checkpoints: find the Brazilian Zouk class or social nearest you — the scene is worldwide and welcoming
the dance's next chapters (connection, tilts, and eventually head movement) all live in that room
arrive with your lateral automatic and your lineage story straight
